svg.aria-label: Three teaching diagnostics. A: substrate attenuation through a uniform film, L=2.5 nm. B: equal-area signals under uniform or differential charging show how potential distributions produce shoulders. C: constructed oxygen fractions for three independent specimens per condition; horizontal marks show means and error bars show sample standard deviations.
